name: Weekly training recap
description: This week's training in numbers against last week, plus one suggestion for next week. The numbers come from the training log; the coach adds the suggestion.

steps.name: Write the weekly recap
steps.prompt: Write this week's training recap. First call training_recap for the week's numbers: sessions, minutes, and the change from last week. Then call save_recap once with ONE concrete suggestion for next week, in one sentence, grounded in those numbers. Do not write the recap file yourself; save_recap writes it.
